review.note: Essence-crop farming: seeds grow essences that craft into resources, by tiers (inferium to supremium). Resource crops are defined in ModCrops.java (see yields/mystical-agriculture.json: iron is a tier 3 crop). Machines that use FE: seed reprocessor, soul extractor, harvester, essence furnace, soulium spawner. Ores in the world (prosperity, inferium, soulium) need ore worldgen. Built-in support: AE2, Create, Draconic Evolution, Mekanism, Powah, Patchouli, Cucumber.
